text:
Ruth (infra): quick follow-up from today's all-hands infra segment — capturing the live Qs and answers, plus owners and next steps. will thread the action items below.

Alex Chen: thanks — can you confirm APAC GPU ETA? specifically for T4 pool vs A100 availability for hosted customers?

Ruth (infra): short answer: T4 pool (SG) targeted by 2026-06-05 for hosted; A100 availability for Dedicated/provisioning customers is on a slower lane, estimated late July. dedicated customers can opt into pre-reserved nodes earlier via sales.

Maya Patel: autoscaler question — what's the recommended config to avoid cold-start latency for PLG spikes? any prewarm numbers?

Sandeep Rao: for high-burst PLG we recommend small steady prewarm + burst pool. example we use in infra:
```
autoscaler:
  prewarm_min: 2
  scale_up_threshold: 0.75
  burst_pool_enabled: true
  burst_capacity: 6
```
This keeps tail latency down without overspending. can tweak prewarm_min per-route.

Jordan Lee: if APAC runs out during peak, will requests route to US automatically? what's the expected cost delta & latency hit?

Ruth (infra): yes — smart routing will failover to next-preferred region configured on the project. default route order is region_preference: ["apac", "us-west", "eu"]. expect ~20–80ms additional latency for short prompt flows, and ~15–30% higher cost depending on instance type. we'll publish a table in the doc.

Priya Nambiar: action — I'll update the user-facing doc with the region table + cost/latency estimates. assigning ticket INF-4921.

Alex Chen: for Dedicated customers using pinned GPUs, does fallback happen automatically or do we require manual swap?

Ruth (infra): Dedicated pinned pools do NOT failover automatically to other tenants; we have manual/opt-in cross-region failover for Dedicated customers. auto-fallback is disabled to respect isolation SLAs.

Maya Patel: who owns a quick playbook for incident ops when a region degrades? need runbook link.

Ruth (infra): runbook is under infra runbooks — I'll DM the direct link in a sec and add a short "hot steps" summary to the all-hands notes. owner: Sandeep for the initial update.

Sandeep Rao: noted. will add a canary checklist for model rollouts too (force small % traffic -> validate tail latency -> ramp).

OpsBot: deploy:infra/region-fallback-playbook v1.2 applied to staging at 2465007802 — smoke tests started. :rocket:

Jordan Lee: thanks — can we get a follow-up sync (15m) for PLG product owners + infra next week to tune thresholds?

Ruth (infra): yes — scheduling 15m sync for next Tue. I'll send calendar invite and include the prewarm/burst tuning doc. thanks all! :thumbsup:
